patches.name: Patch 6 — Master Emulator Consolidation (critical)
patches.summary: RetroArch-style unified emulator. Adapter pattern. Local-first ROM execution. GB/GBC/GBA under one interface.
patches.notes: WasmBoyCore: GB/GBC via WasmBoy v0.7.1. MGBACore: GBA via @thenick775/mgba-wasm v2.4.1 (jsDelivr CDN). COI headers (COOP same-origin + COEP credentialless) injected via gameboy-sw.js to enable SharedArrayBuffer. API: mGBA({canvas,locateFile}) → FSInit → uploadRom(arr,cb) → loadGame → resumeGame/pauseGame/quitGame. Button map: buttonPress/buttonUnpress with Up/Down/Left/Right/A/B/L/R/Start/Select. Requires one SW-controlled page load to activate COI.
remaining: Verify GBA ROM loads in browser (COI headers active after first SW reload)
Save states — snapshot/restore wired to P09

patches.summary: GPT meta-analysis validating JARVIS direction. Key ruling: reduce active God Systems to 8 operational (AYRE/AEGIS/ODIN/SKADI/MNEMOS/HUGINN/HALO/NEMESIS), rest are metadata labels. Boot context load order is most critical improvement. New supreme rule: 'No symbolic expansion without executable compression.'
patches.notes: Read-only advisory. Validates: governance, patch system, GitHub truth, Supabase state, EventBus, replayability, cartridge modularity, TRON/GRID split. Warns against symbolic over-architecture (too many active systems). Reinforces GL7.

patches.name: Patch 25 — Mythos Integration Strategy
patches.summary: Mythos-class frontier models as bounded infrastructure intelligence inside JARVIS. Roles: repo auditor, security analyzer, execution planner, reconciliation engine, cartridge validator, drift detector, code refactor engine. Must NOT have unrestricted autonomy or mutation authority.
patches.notes: Supabase table proposals: event_log, drift_log, cartridge_state, replay_index, grid_nodes, execution_trace, patch_registry. Core rule: AI proposes → humans commit → event bus records → replay engine verifies.

patches.name: Patch 26 — JARVIS System Model Spec (CANON v1.0)
patches.summary: Drop-in canonical spec for all agents. Formalizes Gold Laws GL2/GL5/GL6/GL7/GL8/GL9. 27 God Systems in Tiers 0-9. Execution pipeline, data architecture (GitHub=truth/Supabase=live/GRID=cognition), agent behavior contract, immutability model.
patches.notes: GL9 added: all actions must map intent→decision→execution→log. God System Tiers: T0 foundational (CHAOS/ZEUS/POSEIDON/HADES), T1 execution (AYRE/AEGIS/ODIN/SKADI), T2 timing (KRONOS), T3 memory (MNEMOS/HUGINN/HALO/MIMIR), T4 observability (BIFROST/JANUS), T5 governance (LOKI/ATHENA/PROMETHEUS/ARGUS/NEMESIS), T6 integrity (IRIS/MERIDIAN), T7 interface (DANTE/APOLLO), T8 infrastructure (ATLAS), T9 translation (HERMES).

patches.name: Patch 27 — GRID Place System
patches.summary: Transform GRID into spatial-semantic hybrid: readable as geography (TRON), writable as graph state (JARVIS), stored as event-sourced memory. Entities: NODE/EDGE/REGION/PORTAL/ANCHOR/SHADOW. Place abstraction: world/continent/region/city/building/room/corridor/landmark/fog/void. TRON navigation modes: EXPLORE/ROUTE/DEBUG/REPLAY/BUILD.
patches.notes: Depends on P23 (GRID/TRON split). TRON is read-only — cannot mutate GRID. All GRID mutations go through SKADI+AEGIS. PORTAL = typed transition edge between heterogeneous systems (GitHub↔GRID, Supabase↔regions, Emulator↔runtime).

patches.name: Patch 28 — GRID Runtime Engine
patches.summary: GRID transitions from static structured space to active runtime simulation engine. NODE = stateful actor with tick_fn. EDGE = active causal/temporal/structural/signal/constraint channels. Tick loop: ingest→route(ODIN)→validate(AEGIS)→execute(SKADI)→propagate→reconcile(MNEMOS)→drift(HUGINN)→log. Time modes: real-time/stepped/replay/frozen (KRONOS).
patches.notes: Depends on P27. Global fields: entropy/alignment/pressure/drift. JARVIS sits above GRID as governor, not inside it. Failure modes: drift (HUGINN), loop (NEMESIS), state corruption (LOKI rollback).

patches.name: Patch 29 — GNPL Consensus Engine
patches.summary: Multi-agent graph agreement + conflict resolution for Claude/Codex/GPT/Gemini/Mythos operating on shared GRID state. Consensus Score: alignment×0.35 + consistency×0.25 - redundancy×0.20 + impact×0.20. Three consensus layers: L0 per-node, L1 region, L2 global. Conflict resolution: MERGE/SPLIT/PRUNE/RECLASSIFY for edges; AEGIS>HALO>CS>timestamp for nodes.
patches.notes: Depends on P28. GNPL = event-classified pipeline (PROPOSE/CONFIRM/REJECT/MERGE/DEFER). Only after consensus: GRID apply → Supabase update → GitHub commit → MNEMOS index → TRON visual update.

patches.name: Patch 30 — World Kernel Spec
patches.summary: NODE becomes a WORLD: isolated execution sandbox embedded inside GRID with its own runtime loop, agent hosting, and internal state. World kernel stack: INPUT→GUARD(AEGIS)→ROUTING(ODIN-local)→EXECUTION(SKADI-local)→MEMORY(MNEMOS-local)→CONSENSUS(mini-GNPL)→OUTPUT. World state MUST NOT directly mutate GRID — all external effects via GNPL portal events.
patches.notes: Depends on P28+P29. PORTAL types: input/output/memory/execution. Tick modes: synced/async/burst/frozen. GRID = aggregator of world outputs. Agent types within worlds: worker/planner/observer/stabilizer/simulator.

patches.name: Patch 31 — Mythos Autonomous Governance Layer
patches.summary: Mythos-class frontier models integrated as bounded reasoning engines under strict JARVIS governance. Functions: repo governance, graph compression, security simulation, world generation (NLP→graph-world compiler), multi-agent orchestration, predictive drift analysis, topology optimization. Pipeline: USER→AYRE→AEGIS→ODIN→Mythos→SKADI→GNPL→GRID→GitHub→Supabase→HUGINN.
patches.notes: Depends on P28-P30. Hard rules: no direct GRID mutation (AEGIS), no silent execution (GNPL events), no architecture overwrite (HALO), no uncontrolled recursion (NEMESIS), no irreversible changes without logs (HADES). Mythos proposes — humans commit — event bus records — replay engine verifies.
